== Description ==

Attendees talking in the tournament hall at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025, including [[Mark Billings]] (left, black sunset T-shirt and ponytail), [[Ming Huo]] (centre-left, tan zip hoodie and blue shorts), and [[Steve Harpster]] (centre-right, black zip jacket and white beard); remaining faces unlabeled.
